about:
Mac Auto & Collision is a family-owned body shop on Circle Drive in Bessemer, run by Allen McConathy. For more than three decades, we've repaired vehicles for our neighbors in Bessemer, Hueytown, McCalla, Helena, and the greater Birmingham area.

We're not a chain. When you call, you talk to the people doing the work. We'll tell you straight what your vehicle needs, what it will cost, and how long it will take, and then we'll do exactly that.

headlines.subline: Family-owned in Bessemer. We come to you for the estimate, handle the claim, and fight for the repair you're owed.
Many first estimates are written by software from photos. We inspect the whole car and file for the rest.
Your driveway, your workplace, the tow yard. A written estimate on the spot, then we handle the claim.

headlines.line1: Your car. Your choice of shop.
headlines.subline: Alabama law lets you pick where your car is repaired. Pick the shop that works for you.
